title: Tech Note: Merging Documents In 4D Write Pro
author: Tai Bui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: WP INSERT DOCUMENT and the Write Pro range/target model described here remain 4D's current, fully supported document-merging mechanism; this is core, still-accurate 4D Write Pro API documentation rather than a technique that has been superseded.
related_updates: No successor needed — WP INSERT DOCUMENT is still the standard command for merging 4D Write Pro documents/templates in current 4D versions
4D Write Pro itself has continued to gain features since 2021, but the merge command and range/target model documented here remain unchanged
